items.title: One Cement: NCLT final sanction expected
items.detail: Ambuja expects NCLT approval and effectiveness of the ACC and Orient amalgamations by January 2027. Watch for the NCLT Ahmedabad order.

items.title: Q3 FY27 results season (Oct–Dec quarter)
items.detail: Last year, Q3 results came out between late January and early February (APSEZ Q3 FY26 was announced on 3 Feb 2026). Exact dates appear here automatically once companies notify NSE.

items.title: Ambuja capacity target: 119 MTPA
items.detail: 5.6 MTPA expected to commission or ramp up in H2 FY27 (Bathinda, Jodhpur, Warisaliganj).

items.title: Adani Power: Korba II unit 2 commissioning
items.detail: The second 660 MW unit of Korba Phase II is expected in Q4 FY27; Mahan Phase II follows in early FY28.

items.title: AGEL: BESS guidance above 10 GWh for FY27
items.detail: 6.63 GWh installed by Q2. The company says it may exceed its 10 GWh guidance.

items.title: Q4 FY27 and full-year results season
items.detail: Full-year results and FY28 guidance usually come late April to mid May.

items.title: Annual reports, AGMs and ESG reports
items.detail: Integrated annual reports, BRSR (sustainability reports) and AGMs mostly fall in June. Good primary reading.

items.title: Evos acquisition: indicative completion
items.detail: APSEZ gave an indicative completion window of 15 months from 5 November 2026, subject to EU and other approvals and works-council consultation.

items.title: Ambuja cost target: about ₹4,000 per tonne (FY28)
items.detail: Cost was ₹4,410 per tonne in Q2 FY27. The levers are green power, logistics and fuel.

items.title: AGEL 50 GW and Ambuja 155 MTPA targets
items.detail: These are long-range targets. Track progress each quarter.
